{{Top|leg}}
'''Lowwel''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Lowwel was a [[Thief/Legends|thief]] who used a [[CS-12 Stun Master/Legends|CS-12 Stun Master]] to incapacitate targets after infiltrating [[Starship/Legends|starships]] disguised as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]]. After taking control of the vessel, Lowwel would take the ship to where some accomplices waited so they could plunder as much as possible. Since Lowwel used the [[contact stunner]], none of the victims could identify their attacker, and the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was light because no one was killed.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

Lowwel also believed that weapons like the [[Neuronic whip/Legends|neuronic whip]] were cruel and had no reason to exist, and those that used them, like [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], were evil. Lowwel made these views known on Gundark's Gear Datalog, and was challenged by the slaver [[Ellylyn]].<ref name="GFT" />
